ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High local contrast within the fluke region, characterized by a dominant low-intensity black pigmentation field and high-intensity white pixel concentrations in the form of streaks and circular spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous black pigmentation across approximately 90% of the visible surface. High-intensity white linear blobs are concentrated in the lower sectors of both lobes. High-intensity white circular pixel clusters are mapped exclusively to the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-amplitude, jagged topography along the right lobe trailing edge with six distinct peaks. The left lobe trailing edge exhibits a more continuous, lower-amplitude serration pattern.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curvature fitted to the lateral boundaries of both lobes, terminating in acute distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of circular, high-contrast white pixel groups located at the lateral extremities of both fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous distinct, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) localized primarily on the left lobe and the lower-central region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive physical marking consisting of multiple white rake marks and heavy scarring/encrustation at the lateral tips.
